$comment: Scenario preset. `scenario` is a contract Scenario; `meta` is Experience-owned descriptive content. Hypotheses are authored expectations, never measured outcomes.

meta.summary: Sends an informational app message at 12:00 suggesting Splash Falls, expiring at 13:00. Only guests with the app, delivery and attention can observe it. No discount.
meta.authoredHypothesis: Authored hypothesis (unmeasured): app users who see the message are more likely to travel to Splash Falls.

change.text: Splash Falls is open all day - find it on the path north-west of the central plaza.
